title: More control over how text models think out loud
summary:
A small reliability pass: better text-generation controls, a clearer SillyTavern connection, and auth that handles bad tokens without drama.

Text generation now accepts the full set of common sampling controls: temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, and frequency_penalty. More knobs for people who have opinions about repetition.

SillyTavern was added to the project list and documented in the README, making the connection easier to find for roleplay and character-chat builders.

Authentication and queue handling were standardized, token validation gained a straightforward REST GET endpoint, and invalid tokens no longer have the power to crash a server.
